title: 流感
summary: 流感由流感病毒引起，經飛沫與接觸傳播，秋冬為流行期。長者、幼兒、孕婦與慢性病人易併發重症，每年接種疫苗是最有效的預防方法。

keyFacts.symptoms: 突然發燒、頭痛、肌肉痠痛、倦怠、喉嚨痛、咳嗽
keyFacts.prevention: 每年接種流感疫苗、勤洗手、咳嗽戴口罩

cards.if: 突然發燒、全身痠痛、咳嗽
cards.title: 戴口罩就醫、在家休息
cards.text: 儘早就醫並在家休息，症狀緩解後 24 小時再上班上課；醫師會評估是否開立抗病毒藥劑。

cards.if: 出現呼吸困難、胸痛或意識改變
cards.title: 立即到急診
cards.text: 這些是流感併發重症的危險徵兆，請立即就醫，不要等待。

cards.if: 65 歲以上、幼兒、孕婦或有慢性病
cards.title: 10 月 1 日起接種公費疫苗
cards.text: 公費流感疫苗每年 10 月 1 日開打，可查詢住家附近的合約院所。

blocks.heading: 症狀與警示徵象
blocks.markdown:
流感常見症狀為**突然**發燒、頭痛、肌肉痠痛、疲倦、流鼻水、喉嚨痛及咳嗽，部分兒童會有腹瀉、嘔吐。多數人約一週內可康復。

與一般感冒不同的是，流感發病急、全身症狀明顯，且可能併發肺炎、腦炎、心肌炎等嚴重併發症。
blocks.warning: 呼吸急促或困難、發紺（嘴唇發紫）、血痰或痰液變濃、胸痛、意識改變、低血壓；兒童另需留意持續高燒超過 3 天、抽搐、活力明顯變差。

blocks.heading: 怎麼傳染
blocks.markdown:
流感主要透過病人咳嗽、打噴嚏產生的**飛沫**傳播，也可能因手接觸到病人的口鼻分泌物或被污染的物品，再碰觸自己的眼口鼻而感染。

病人在發病前 1 天至症狀出現後 3–7 天都可能具有傳染力，幼兒與免疫力低下者排毒時間可能更長。

blocks.heading: 如何預防
blocks.markdown:
- **每年接種流感疫苗**：病毒每年會變異，疫苗成分也每年更新，需每年接種。
- 勤洗手，咳嗽或打噴嚏時以衣袖或紙巾遮住口鼻。
- 有呼吸道症狀時戴口罩，生病在家休息，避免出入人多擁擠的場所。
- 流行期間探視長照機構或醫院時，請先確認自己沒有發燒或咳嗽。

blocks.heading: 診斷與治療
blocks.markdown:
醫師可依臨床判斷開立抗病毒藥劑（如口服克流感、吸入型瑞樂沙、靜脈注射瑞貝塔、口服紓伏效）。**發病後 48 小時內**使用效果最好，但重症或高風險病人即使超過 48 小時仍可使用。

符合公費使用對象者，由疾管署提供公費抗病毒藥劑，對象條件請見專業版「公費流感抗病毒藥劑使用對象」。退燒止痛以乙醯胺酚為主，18 歲以下避免使用阿斯匹靈。

blocks.heading: 疫苗
blocks.markdown:
公費流感疫苗每年 10 月 1 日起分階段開打，對象包括 65 歲以上長者、6 個月以上至國小入學前幼兒、孕婦、高風險慢性病人、醫事及防疫人員、國小至高中職學生等，50–64 歲成人於第二階段開放。

8 歲（含）以下兒童若是第一次接種，需接種 2 劑，間隔 4 週以上。完整對象與時程請見「流感疫苗」頁。

blocks.heading: 目前疫情與統計
blocks.markdown: 類流感門急診就診率、流感併發重症病例數每週由疫情中心更新；流行期間疫情態勢層會標示目前狀態。

professional.specimen: 咽喉擦拭液或鼻咽擦拭液，以病毒保存輸送管保存，4°C 冷藏 48 小時內送驗；可進行病毒分離與 RT-PCR。
professional.notifyNote: 「流感併發重症」為第四類法定傳染病，應於一週內通報；類流感病例不須逐案通報，由定點醫師監測與健保資料掌握。

en.title: Influenza
en.summary: Influenza is caused by influenza viruses spread by droplets and contact, peaking in autumn and winter. Older adults, young children, pregnant women and people with chronic conditions are at higher risk of severe disease; an annual vaccine is the most effective protection.

keyFacts.symptoms: Sudden fever, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, sore throat, cough
keyFacts.prevention: Annual flu vaccine, hand washing, mask when coughing
keyFacts.notify: Severe complicated influenza: within one week

cards.if: have sudden fever, body aches and cough
cards.title: Wear a mask, see a doctor and rest at home
cards.text: See a doctor early and stay home until 24 hours after symptoms improve; the doctor will assess whether antivirals are needed.

cards.if: have difficulty breathing, chest pain or confusion
cards.title: Go to the emergency department now
cards.text: These are danger signs of severe influenza. Seek care immediately.

cards.if: are 65+, a young child, pregnant or have a chronic condition
cards.title: Get the government-funded vaccine from 1 October
cards.text: Government-funded flu vaccination starts on 1 October each year; find a contracted clinic near you.

blocks.heading: Symptoms and warning signs
blocks.markdown:
Common symptoms are **sudden** fever, headache, muscle aches, fatigue, runny nose, sore throat and cough; some children have diarrhoea or vomiting. Most people recover within about a week.

Unlike a common cold, influenza starts abruptly with marked whole-body symptoms and can lead to pneumonia, encephalitis or myocarditis.
blocks.warning: Rapid or difficult breathing, cyanosis (blue lips), bloody or thick sputum, chest pain, altered consciousness, low blood pressure; in children also high fever for more than 3 days, seizures or marked loss of activity.

blocks.heading: How it spreads
blocks.markdown:
Influenza spreads mainly through **droplets** from coughs and sneezes. It can also spread when hands touch secretions or contaminated objects and then the eyes, nose or mouth.

People may be infectious from 1 day before to 3–7 days after symptoms start; young children and immunocompromised people may shed virus longer.

blocks.heading: Prevention
blocks.markdown:
- **Get vaccinated every year**: the virus changes and the vaccine is updated annually.
- Wash hands often; cover coughs and sneezes with a sleeve or tissue.
- Wear a mask when you have respiratory symptoms, stay home when sick and avoid crowds.
- During flu season, make sure you have no fever or cough before visiting care homes or hospitals.

blocks.heading: Diagnosis and treatment
blocks.markdown:
Doctors may prescribe antivirals (oral oseltamivir, inhaled zanamivir, intravenous peramivir or oral baloxavir). They work best **within 48 hours of onset**, but severe or high-risk patients can still benefit later.

Taiwan CDC supplies government-funded antivirals for eligible patients; see the professional document on eligibility. Use paracetamol for fever and avoid aspirin in anyone under 18.

blocks.heading: Vaccine
blocks.markdown:
Government-funded flu vaccination starts in phases from 1 October each year for people aged 65 and over, children from 6 months to school entry, pregnant women, high-risk chronic patients, health and public health workers, and primary to senior high school students; adults aged 50–64 are included in the second phase.

Children aged 8 and under receiving flu vaccine for the first time need 2 doses at least 4 weeks apart. See the Influenza vaccine page for details.

blocks.heading: Current situation and statistics
blocks.markdown: Influenza-like illness visit rates and severe influenza cases are updated weekly by the Epidemic Intelligence Center; the situation layer shows the current status during the season.

id.title: Influenza (flu)
id.summary: Influenza disebabkan oleh virus influenza yang menyebar melalui percikan dan kontak, dengan puncak pada musim gugur dan dingin. Lansia, anak kecil, ibu hamil, dan orang dengan penyakit kronis berisiko lebih tinggi sakit berat; vaksin tahunan adalah perlindungan paling efektif.

keyFacts.symptoms: Demam mendadak, sakit kepala, nyeri otot, lelah, sakit tenggorokan, batuk
keyFacts.transmission: Percikan dan kontak dengan cairan pernapasan
keyFacts.prevention: Vaksin flu setiap tahun, cuci tangan, pakai masker saat batuk
keyFacts.notify: Influenza dengan komplikasi berat: dalam satu minggu

blocks.heading: Gejala dan tanda bahaya
blocks.markdown:
Gejala umum adalah demam **mendadak**, sakit kepala, nyeri otot, lelah, pilek, sakit tenggorokan, dan batuk; sebagian anak mengalami diare atau muntah. Kebanyakan orang sembuh dalam sekitar satu minggu.

Berbeda dengan pilek biasa, influenza mulai tiba-tiba dengan gejala seluruh tubuh yang jelas dan dapat menyebabkan radang paru, radang otak, atau radang otot jantung.
blocks.warning: Napas cepat atau sulit bernapas, bibir kebiruan, dahak berdarah atau kental, nyeri dada, kesadaran menurun, tekanan darah rendah; pada anak juga demam tinggi lebih dari 3 hari, kejang, atau sangat lesu.

blocks.heading: Pencegahan
blocks.markdown:
- **Vaksin setiap tahun**: virus terus berubah dan vaksin diperbarui setiap tahun.
- Sering cuci tangan; tutup mulut saat batuk dan bersin dengan lengan baju atau tisu.
- Pakai masker bila ada gejala pernapasan, tetap di rumah saat sakit, dan hindari keramaian.
- Selama musim flu, pastikan tidak demam atau batuk sebelum menjenguk panti jompo atau rumah sakit.

vi.title: Cúm
vi.summary: Cúm do vi-rút cúm gây ra, lây qua giọt bắn và tiếp xúc, cao điểm vào mùa thu và mùa đông. Người cao tuổi, trẻ nhỏ, phụ nữ mang thai và người có bệnh mạn tính có nguy cơ bệnh nặng cao hơn; tiêm vắc-xin hằng năm là cách bảo vệ hiệu quả nhất.

keyFacts.symptoms: Sốt đột ngột, đau đầu, đau cơ, mệt mỏi, đau họng, ho
keyFacts.transmission: Giọt bắn và tiếp xúc với dịch tiết
keyFacts.prevention: Tiêm vắc-xin cúm hằng năm, rửa tay, đeo khẩu trang khi ho
keyFacts.notify: Cúm biến chứng nặng: trong vòng một tuần

blocks.heading: Triệu chứng và dấu hiệu cảnh báo
blocks.markdown:
Triệu chứng thường gặp là sốt **đột ngột**, đau đầu, đau cơ, mệt mỏi, sổ mũi, đau họng và ho; một số trẻ bị tiêu chảy hoặc nôn. Đa số khỏi trong khoảng một tuần.

Khác với cảm lạnh thông thường, cúm khởi phát đột ngột với triệu chứng toàn thân rõ rệt và có thể dẫn đến viêm phổi, viêm não hoặc viêm cơ tim.
blocks.warning: Thở nhanh hoặc khó thở, môi tím tái, đờm có máu hoặc đặc, đau ngực, rối loạn ý thức, huyết áp thấp; ở trẻ em còn có sốt cao trên 3 ngày, co giật hoặc lừ đừ rõ rệt.

blocks.heading: Phòng ngừa
blocks.markdown:
- **Tiêm vắc-xin mỗi năm**: vi-rút thay đổi và vắc-xin được cập nhật hằng năm.
- Thường xuyên rửa tay; che miệng khi ho, hắt hơi bằng tay áo hoặc khăn giấy.
- Đeo khẩu trang khi có triệu chứng hô hấp, ở nhà khi bị bệnh và tránh nơi đông người.
- Trong mùa cúm, hãy chắc chắn mình không sốt, không ho trước khi vào thăm viện dưỡng lão hoặc bệnh viện.

th.title: ไข้หวัดใหญ่
th.summary: ไข้หวัดใหญ่เกิดจากเชื้อไวรัสไข้หวัดใหญ่ แพร่ทางละอองฝอยและการสัมผัส ระบาดมากในฤดูใบไม้ร่วงและฤดูหนาว ผู้สูงอายุ เด็กเล็ก หญิงตั้งครรภ์ และผู้มีโรคเรื้อรังเสี่ยงป่วยรุนแรงมากกว่า การฉีดวัคซีนทุกปีเป็นการป้องกันที่ได้ผลที่สุด

keyFacts.incubation: 1–4 วัน (เฉลี่ย 2 วัน)
keyFacts.symptoms: ไข้เฉียบพลัน ปวดศีรษะ ปวดเมื่อยกล้ามเนื้อ อ่อนเพลีย เจ็บคอ ไอ
keyFacts.transmission: ละอองฝอยและการสัมผัสสารคัดหลั่ง
keyFacts.prevention: ฉีดวัคซีนไข้หวัดใหญ่ทุกปี ล้างมือ สวมหน้ากากเมื่อไอ
keyFacts.notify: ไข้หวัดใหญ่ที่มีภาวะแทรกซ้อนรุนแรง: ภายในหนึ่งสัปดาห์

blocks.heading: อาการและสัญญาณอันตราย
blocks.markdown:
อาการที่พบบ่อยคือมีไข้**เฉียบพลัน** ปวดศีรษะ ปวดเมื่อยกล้ามเนื้อ อ่อนเพลีย น้ำมูกไหล เจ็บคอ และไอ เด็กบางคนอาจท้องเสียหรืออาเจียน ส่วนใหญ่หายภายในประมาณหนึ่งสัปดาห์

ต่างจากไข้หวัดธรรมดา ไข้หวัดใหญ่เริ่มอย่างกะทันหัน มีอาการทั่วร่างกายชัดเจน และอาจทำให้เกิดปอดอักเสบ สมองอักเสบ หรือกล้ามเนื้อหัวใจอักเสบ
blocks.warning: หายใจเร็วหรือหายใจลำบาก ริมฝีปากเขียว เสมหะปนเลือดหรือข้น เจ็บหน้าอก ความรู้สึกตัวเปลี่ยนแปลง ความดันต่ำ ในเด็กยังรวมถึงไข้สูงเกิน 3 วัน ชัก หรือซึมมาก

blocks.heading: การป้องกัน
blocks.markdown:
- **ฉีดวัคซีนทุกปี** เพราะไวรัสเปลี่ยนแปลงและวัคซีนปรับปรุงทุกปี
- ล้างมือบ่อย ๆ ปิดปากเวลาไอหรือจามด้วยแขนเสื้อหรือกระดาษทิชชู
- สวมหน้ากากเมื่อมีอาการทางเดินหายใจ พักอยู่บ้านเมื่อป่วย และหลีกเลี่ยงที่แออัด
- ในฤดูไข้หวัดใหญ่ ก่อนไปเยี่ยมบ้านพักคนชราหรือโรงพยาบาล ต้องแน่ใจว่าไม่มีไข้และไม่ไอ

tl.title: Trangkaso (influenza)
tl.summary: Ang trangkaso ay dulot ng influenza virus na kumakalat sa talsik ng laway at paghawak, at dumarami tuwing taglagas at taglamig. Mas mataas ang panganib ng malubhang sakit sa matatanda, maliliit na bata, buntis, at may malalang sakit; ang taunang bakuna ang pinakamabisang proteksyon.

keyFacts.symptoms: Biglaang lagnat, sakit ng ulo, pananakit ng kalamnan, pagkapagod, sakit ng lalamunan, ubo
keyFacts.transmission: Talsik ng laway at paghawak sa likido ng may sakit
keyFacts.prevention: Taunang bakuna laban sa trangkaso, paghuhugas ng kamay, mask kapag umuubo
keyFacts.notify: Malubhang komplikasyon ng trangkaso: sa loob ng isang linggo

blocks.heading: Mga sintomas at babalang senyales
blocks.markdown:
Karaniwang sintomas ang **biglaang** lagnat, sakit ng ulo, pananakit ng kalamnan, pagkapagod, sipon, sakit ng lalamunan, at ubo; may mga batang nagtatae o nagsusuka. Gumagaling ang karamihan sa loob ng mga isang linggo.

Iba sa karaniwang sipon, biglaan ang simula ng trangkaso, malinaw ang sintomas sa buong katawan, at maaaring humantong sa pulmonya, pamamaga ng utak, o pamamaga ng puso.
blocks.warning: Mabilis o hirap na paghinga, pangangasul ng labi, plemang may dugo o malapot, pananakit ng dibdib, pagbabago ng malay, mababang presyon; sa bata, lagnat nang higit 3 araw, kombulsyon, o labis na panghihina.

blocks.heading: Pag-iwas
blocks.markdown:
- **Magpabakuna taon-taon**: nagbabago ang virus at ina-update ang bakuna bawat taon.
- Madalas na maghugas ng kamay; takpan ang ubo at bahing gamit ang manggas o tisyu.
- Magsuot ng mask kapag may sintomas sa paghinga, manatili sa bahay kapag may sakit, at iwasan ang mataong lugar.
- Sa panahon ng trangkaso, tiyaking wala kang lagnat o ubo bago bumisita sa nursing home o ospital.
